integrity: The primary arXiv record explicitly lists primary MSC 03E55 and first submission 2026-09-21. Osinski Definition 3.2, Definition 5.3, and Corollary 5.9 were checked in full HTML. Luecke--Poveda Theorem 1.3 and its Section 3 proof were checked in full HTML. The deduction applies Osinski's ZFC theorem internally to the transitive ZFC model supplied by Luecke--Poveda.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is internal to a transitive set-sized model of ZFC and supplies only an upper relative-consistency bound from an I2-embedding. It does not assert ambient-universe compactness, a lower bound, or equiconsistency with I2.
title: An \(I2\) embedding gives a transitive model of universal rank-type compactness
